abilities.critical_failure: The creature takes 4d8+9 force damage and is fatigued.
abilities.effect: Three aiudara wraiths screech in unison and manifest to protect the arch. Each creature within 30 feet must attempt a DC 27 Will save. The haunt rolls initiative.
abilities.name: Forceful Screech

traits.name: Divine
traits.text:
This magic comes from the divine tradition, drawing power from deities or similar sources. Anything with this trait is magical.  
  
A creature with this trait is primarily constituted of or has a strong connection to divine magic.

abilities.trigger: A creature comes within 30 feet of the aiudara

traits.name: Magical
traits.text: Something with the magical trait is imbued with magical energies not tied to a specific tradition of magic. Some items or effects are closely tied to a particular tradition of magic. In these cases, the item has the arcane, divine, occult, or primal trait instead of the magical trait. Any of these traits indicate that the item is magical.

hazard.description: The spiritual imprints of long-dead explorers haunt this *aiudara*, manifesting as a trio of astral wraiths who guard the gateway jealously.
hazard.disable: DC 25 Religion (trained) to exorcise one of the wraiths or DC 25 Occultism (expert) to erase one of the wraith’s astral sigils; three successful checks are required to disable the haunt
hazard.name: Haunted Aiudara
hazard.reset: The aiudara wraiths disperse after 1 minute, but the haunt resets after 24 hours.
hazard.routine:
(3 actions; divine, teleportation) With spectral claws, the aiudara wraiths hurl trespassers through time and space. Each of the three wraiths has 1 action which it can use to make a forceful hand Strike against a creature within 60 feet. The haunt loses 1 action for each successful check to disable the haunt.  
When the haunt rolls a critical hit to Strike a creature, the creature is instantly shunted to an empty space within 30 feet. The haunt chooses which space the creature is transported to.

traits.name: Complex
traits.text: A hazard with this trait takes turns in an encounter.

traits.name: Haunt
traits.text: A hazard with this trait is a spiritual echo, often of someone with a tragic death. Putting a haunt to rest often involves resolving the haunt’s unfinished business. A haunt that hasn’t been properly put to rest always returns after a time.
